title_zh: 用桌面摆锤模型解释重力

scenario.label_zh: 用桌面摆锤模型解释重力
scenario.goal_zh: 澄清摆锤下降与重力的关系，并约定先放手观察而不是用力推动

context_zh: 科学老师与成年学习者使用低矮桌面上的软球摆锤模型，不使用大型或危险装置。
author: author-phase11-a

sentences.speaker: Nadia
sentences.text: I still cannot grasp why the ball speeds up as it swings downward.

sentences.speaker: Felix
sentences.text: Gravity pulls the ball downward, so it gains speed as it moves toward the bottom of its swing. We can watch that on this little model.

sentences.speaker: Nadia
sentences.text: Should I give it a push?

sentences.speaker: Felix
sentences.text: Not for this comparison. Keep a light grip on the soft ball, then open your hand without pushing.

sentences.speaker: Nadia
sentences.text: So we are observing what happens from a release, not adding an extra shove.

sentences.speaker: Felix
sentences.text: Exactly. Let us watch one swing first, then talk about the change in speed.
